title: Men without names or uniforms
situation: Videos show men in jeans and white shirts carrying police lathis and hitting protesters, and uniformed personnel without name tags. Police HQ then orders Jantar Mantar duty in uniform only.
where: Parliament Street to Transport Bhawan, New Delhi

who.officer: unidentified men in plain clothes, uniformed police without tags

lines.text: "Mild force" was used after protesters breached multiple barricades (internal police report).
lines.speaker: New Delhi district police

paraphrased: A sung reel verse mentioned plainclothes men and missing nameplates (DT Next).

buildThis.situation: At the charge, some lathi-swingers wear white shirts and jeans, not khaki; the player who looks for a nameplate before reacting learns who is who.

sources.publisher: DT Next (agency copy, also in Outlook)
